stage0025_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$アルト$$
「That's not all!
　There are machines from all sorts of groups, too!」

stage0025_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$n
「There's no choice, Miss Suzune!
　Until the Quarter or the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ arrive,
　we have to protect the city ourselves!」

stage0025_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I know that, but!
　Can you even fight!?」

stage0025_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$スズネ$$
（Are they scared...?
　Does it have to do with their eyes turning red...）

stage0025_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...All right.
　But promise me you won't push yourself.」

stage0025_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'm counting on you, $n, Miss $$スズネ$$!」

stage0025_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$カレン$$
「$$トウジ$$, $$ケンスケ$$, $$ヒカリ$$!
　Don't you dare stray from us!」

stage0025_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$n
（I have to fight...!
　This feeling... it must be nearby...）

stage0025_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I don't like it. That blue machine...」

stage0025_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Up close, I like it even less.
　Honestly...」

stage0025_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$田中司令$$
「$$甲児$$ and his school friends are safely aboard.」

stage0025_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$カレン$$
「$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$!
　You were on the Quarter too!」

stage0025_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「We've plenty to catch up on, but later.
　I have something $$ルルーシュ$$ left with me.」

stage0025_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「I've got the bandana ready too.
　Use it.」

stage0025_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$カレン$$
「Thanks!
　Now I can fight too!」

stage0025_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
Kallen
「That's right, $$キリコ$$!
　$$紅月カレン$$... reporting back!」

stage0025_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$クラン$$
「So the cargo $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ brought aboard
　was the S.E.I.T.E.N. Eight Elements!」

stage0025_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$カレン$$!
　I need you to back up $n!」

stage0025_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
Kallen
「I'm $$紅月カレン$$.
　Former captain of $$ゼロ$$'s guard in the Black Knights.」

stage0025_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$カレン$$
「I'll take point!
　You back me up!」

stage0025_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$カレン$$
「Cut it out already!
　Think I'd leave someone fighting while scared!?」

stage0025_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$カレン$$
「If you want to act tough,
　do something about that shaky voice first.」

stage0025_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Skull Leader to all units!
　Leave $n to $$カレン$$,
　the rest of us hit the Unknowns!」

stage0025_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Them... invaders from another dimension after all...」

stage0025_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Transferring in while the dimensional boundary
　is stable, of all things...」

stage0025_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$赤木$$
「Whoever you are,
　if you're taking everyone's peace away,
　we'll be the ones to face you!」

stage0025_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, commence attack!
　Intercept the Unknowns!」

stage0025_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$カレン$$
「Here I come!
　You'll be the opponents in my comeback fight!」

stage0025_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$キャシー$$
「The dimensional boundary is distorting!」

stage0025_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「A dimensional tremor... or could it be a $$時空震動$$!?」

stage0025_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$オットー$$
「What's going on!?
　Weren't $$時空震動$$s supposed to be over!?」

stage0025_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$竜馬$$
「This ain't like the bats we've fought before!」

stage0025_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$正太郎$$
「That humanoid machine,
　it's the one that showed up when $$ジェニオン$$ came here!」

stage0025_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「All units, disperse...
　Annihilate the enemy force.」

stage0025_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Captain!
　The Unknowns are ignoring our transmissions!」

stage0025_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Safe to say they have no intention of a ceasefire.」

stage0025_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$オットー$$
「No choice, then!
　We return fire!」

stage0025_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$アムロ$$
「All units, target the machine held back in the rear!
　That's the commander's unit!」

stage0025_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Coming at us, are you, Earthlings...」

stage0025_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Ignorant fools of the frontier.
　I'll show you the power of G...!」

stage0025_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「You've done more than I expected...
　I'll allow that you're an obstacle to the plan.」

stage0025_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「You've done more than I expected...!
　But!」

stage0025_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「For now, call it an obstacle to the plan.」

stage0025_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$カレン$$
「What kind of nonsense...!
　Just who the hell are you people!?」

stage0025_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$n
「If you won't answer, I'll force it out of you!」

stage0025_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$カレン$$
「Don't get the wrong idea...
　I just didn't want you to push
　yourself any harder than this...!」

stage0025_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$カレン$$
「Anyone who can't face their own fear
　has no business on a battlefield!」

stage0025_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「I have no interest in your reasons!
　But since you chased me this far, prepare yourself!」

stage0025_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$n
「I won't die in a place like this!!」

stage0025_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Tch... that machine...!
　What in the world is this!?」

stage0025_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$葵$$
「I never knew $$ジェニオン$$ had a function like that...」

stage0025_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$マオ$$
「This is bad!
　They've lost consciousness!」

stage0025_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I like that blue one even less now...」

stage0025_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Not just hurting little $$アンナロッタ$$,
　but bringing out something like that too...」

stage0025_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Ah, whatever...
　We've got a big job waiting on our end...
　I'll let this slide until then.」

stage0025_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
Trooper
「As I thought, they're the right ones for the job...」

stage0025_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
???
「Delightful news.
　Then we'll watch for a chance to reach out ourselves.」

stage0025_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Even with things in space so unstable,
　to think guys like this would show up too...!」

stage0025_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Where are you, $$シャア$$...!
　Humanity doesn't have the luxury
　of Earth and the colonies fighting each other!」

stage0025_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$シン$$
「I don't know who you are,
　but if you want a war, I'll be your opponent!」

stage0025_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$シン$$
「I'll protect them, I swear!
　Earth, $$プラント$$, everyone, all of them!」

stage0025_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
（I'll fight for peace in my own way...!）

stage0025_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Even a man like me can do something for the world...!」

stage0025_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$リリーナ$$...!
　The peace you all built, I will protect it, I swear!」

stage0025_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「So, $$トレーズ$$...!
　Joining you will have to wait a while longer!」

stage0025_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$バナージ$$
「If I stay in this unit,
　I'll end up fighting people like this too...!」

stage0025_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$バナージ$$
「But still...!
　$$オードリー$$ acted to stop the war too!
　So then, I will too!」

stage0025_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$赤木$$
「$$界震$$s have gotten less frequent,
　but $$ダイ・ガード$$'s gotten stronger!
　I'm gonna use that power to the fullest!」

stage0025_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$青山$$
「Seems like he's really happy
　to be able to fight for peace.」

stage0025_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$赤木$$
「Don't get the wrong idea, $$青山$$.
　I still think it'd be best
　if $$ダイ・ガード$$ never had to scramble at all.」

stage0025_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$赤木$$
「But if $$ダイ・ガード$$'s strength is ever needed,
　I'll just give it everything I've got!」

stage0025_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$青山$$
「Then give us your usual fighting spirit.」

stage0025_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$赤木$$
「Here we goooo!
　Even a salaryman can protect the peace!」

stage0025_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$タケル$$
「Even with the Demon King's threat closing in,
　now a new enemy shows up too...!」

stage0025_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$タケル$$
「But we won't lose!
　As long as this vow to peace lives in my heart,
　no enemy will make us back down!」

stage0025_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I'm not the only one fighting...）

stage0025_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$シンジ$$
（There's $$赤木$$, $$甲児$$, and Rei too...）

stage0025_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Mr. $$扇$$... you don't need to worry.
　I intend to do what I can do.）

stage0025_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$カレン$$
「I was going to play the quiet student,
　but this doesn't look like the time for that!」

stage0025_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$カレン$$
「Fine...!
　I'll make up my mind too!」

stage0025_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$カレン$$
「This is the peace so many people wished for...!
　I'll fight to protect it too!」

stage0025_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$n
「...Sorry, Miss $$スズネ$$...
　But I... maybe I've been fighting
　for a day like today all along!」

stage0025_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「I don't like that machine's existence...!」

stage0025_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$n
「This person...!
　You know about $$ジェニオン$$!?」

stage0025_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「I have no interest in names...!
　But you who wield power beyond your worth
　have invited your own ruin!」

stage0025_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Before you truly fall into despair,
　I myself will deliver the final blow!」
